title: Copilot Credits: the shared meter for usage-based AI billing
summary: The billing mechanisms, licensing qualifications, controls and reporting limits are supported by Microsoft documentation. The flagged allocation API and agent-limit navigation are documented; add the missing supporting references for the billing overview and alert resource.

claims.claim: Copilot Credits are the common currency for eligible Microsoft services with usage-based billing.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits are a common currency for eligible Microsoft services with usage-based billing.

claims.claim: Usage-based billing charges for work performed rather than a flat per-user fee.
claims.quote: Usage-based billing means charges are based on the work performed rather than a flat per-user fee.
